chains.trait: Rooted female cones & pheromone-driven male drones
links: Anchor in fungal-cemented soil and centralize reproduction -> biogenic mound topography where calcareous groundwater fuses with hyphae -> dense humid air efficiently transports volatile chemical signals -> 1.1 bar pressure and stable temperature inversions minimize attenuation

skill.effect: The creature releases a strong pheromone cloud that guides nearby male Temptors to either gather supplies or stand guard for a short while.

chains.weakness: Sessile females cannot flee; ground-penetrating attacks bypass their pheromone shields.
observe: Beaked, cone-shaped females fused to fungal mounds
Male foragers moving with stiff, obedient posture
Pulsating pit-like mating structures emitting faint vapor

journal.en: A forest that thinks with one head, and moves with many.

plausibility.summary: Model sessile females as rooted pelvis/hyphal cement in F12 mounds with obligate male provisioning; pheromone command range scales with humidity and inversion, not unlimited.
fixes: Model sessile females as rooted pelvis/hyphal cement in F12 mounds with obligate male provisioning; pheromone command range scales with humidity and inversion, not unlimited.

analogues.organism: Deep-sea anglerfish (extreme dimorphism); ant/bees (queen pheromone regulation of workers)
analogues.mechanism: as named by the judge; no mechanism or reference recorded
see the cited works; chain wording is the council's own

links: Pheromone tracking across mound forests -> dense air + temp inversions carry low-frequency chemical gradients -> 15°C surface temp stabilizes volatile diffusion rates -> male sensory organs shift to narrow-band olfactory detection

skill.effect: The creature moves swiftly along pheromone trails and makes hidden male drones visible to the eye.

chains.weakness: Easily confused by synthetic chemicals or strong winds.
observe: Deep nasal slits along the muzzle

journal.en: They navigate by breath, not by sight.

plausibility.summary: Use volatile concentration gradients (not 'low-frequency chemical'); stiff gait = display/neuromotor drone phenotype; scent confusion in wind stays.
fixes: Use volatile concentration gradients (not 'low-frequency chemical'); stiff gait = display/neuromotor drone phenotype; scent confusion in wind stays.

relations.note: Temptor mound forests stabilize microclimates that sustain insect swarms; Insectophagi harvest these colonies, inadvertently aerating soil for Temptor root networks.
